title: Leibniz: Sämtliche Schriften und Briefe, Reihe VIII (Naturwissenschaftliche, medizinische und technische Schriften)
author: Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz
institution: Leibniz-Edition Berlin (Berlin-Brandenburgische Akademie der Wissenschaften) and TELOTA
notes: Series VIII of the historical-critical edition of Leibniz: his scientific, medical and technical writings. Volume 1 (1668-1676) and volume 2 (1668-1676) are wholly in the period; volume 3 (mechanics 1, 1671-1705) mostly; volume 4 (1676-1715) later, and is online only as PDF. Free PDFs (same pagination as the print) are on the site and the BBAW repository; LaTeX and TEI data for volumes 1-3 are on GitHub (CC BY-NC 4.0). The TEI files are 3.8, 6.2 and 10.1 MB for volumes 1, 2 and 3. No word or text count is given: the TEI holds editorial apparatus, commentary and German headings together with Leibniz's Latin, French and German texts, and in volumes 3 and 4 many pieces date after 1700. Volume 4 was added in 2024-2025.
